title: VPN and Hybrid Connectivity for Developers
description: Understand how Azure VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute connect on-premises networks to Azure for hybrid scenarios.

data.text: Most enterprises need to connect their on-premises data center to Azure. Azure VPN Gateway creates secure IPsec tunnels over the internet. ExpressRoute creates a private connection through a telecom provider.
For developers, hybrid connectivity matters when your app needs to access on-premises databases, legacy systems, or corporate Active Directory.

data.title: Connectivity Options
items: Site-to-Site VPN — connect an entire office network to Azure
Point-to-Site VPN — connect individual developer machines to Azure
ExpressRoute — private, high-bandwidth connection through a provider
VNet Peering — connect two VNets within the same region

data.title: Create a VPN Gateway (Azure CLI)
data.content: Set up a VPN gateway in your VNet for site-to-site connectivity.
data.code:
az network public-ip create   --name vpn-gateway-pip   --resource-group myRG   --sku Standard   --allocation-method Dynamic

az network vnet-gateway create   --name myVpnGateway   --resource-group myRG   --public-ip-address vpn-gateway-pip   --vnet myVNet   --gateway-type Vpn   --vpn-type RouteBased   --sku VpnGw1

data.title: Connect a Point-to-Site VPN Profile
data.content: Download a VPN profile for a developer to connect their laptop to Azure.
data.code:
# Generate a VPN profile package
az network vnet-gateway reset-vpn-client-script   --name myVpnGateway   --resource-group myRG

# The profile can then be downloaded and imported into Windows/macOS VPN clients

data.caption: Hybrid connectivity options connecting on-premises to Azure.
data.definition:
flowchart TB

    Dev["Developer Laptop"] -->|"Point-to-Site VPN"| VPN
    OnPrem -->|"ExpressRoute"| ER["ExpressRoute Circuit"]
    VPN --> VNet["Azure VNet"]
    ER --> VNet

data.title: Set Up a Point-to-Site VPN
data.description: Configure a Point-to-Site VPN so you can connect your development machine to an Azure VNet.
steps: Create a VPN gateway in your VNet.
Configure a Point-to-Site address pool and certificate.
Download the VPN profile and import it into your OS.
Connect and verify you can reach a VM in the VNet by its private IP.
data.expectedOutcome: Your laptop has a private IP in the Azure VNet range and can access resources directly.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: VPN Gateway uses IPsec over the internet for site-to-site or point-to-site connections.
ExpressRoute is a private, high-throughput connection through a telecom partner.
Point-to-Site VPN is useful for developers accessing Azure resources from a laptop.
data.takeaway: Use VPN Gateway for internet-based hybrid connectivity. Use ExpressRoute when you need guaranteed bandwidth and no internet traversal.
